summary: Kootenai County tower: camp lookout from 1923, present 67-ft R-6 tower from 1963, last staffed in the 1970s, removed in July 2015. Ground house remains per NHLR.

facts.design: 67-foot treated timber tower with R-6 flat cab (present tower from 1963); an earlier 50-foot pole tower (1926) and a 54-foot steel tower (1941)
facts.agency: U.S. Forest Service, Idaho Panhandle National Forests (Coeur d'Alene River Ranger District, Fernan Office)
facts.status_note: Torn down by the Forest Service in July 2015. NHLR says the ground house remains.

access.note: National forest land; no closure or access rule found in the sources. Sources describe the tower as easy to reach before it was removed. Nothing is described about the site since 2022.

visit.trail_note: The tower is gone. Only the ground house is said to remain.

events.note: 50-foot pole tower with a 7 by 7 foot cab
Log cabin added for living quarters
54-foot steel tower (NHLR). The Forest Lookouts list gives a 46-foot Aermotor MC-40 tower for the same year
Two 19-year-old women, Mabel Rose and Marjorie Olson, recorded as the staff in a newspaper item quoted on the Forest Lookouts page
Steel tower moved to Long Mountain
Present 67-foot treated timber tower with R-6 flat cab. The Forest Lookouts list gives 1952 for this tower
Latest named staff on the firelookout.com list (Terrence Meersman). NHLR says not staffed since the 1970s
Registered August 9, 2011 per NHLR. FFLOS gives July 9, 2011 for the listing
Tower removed in July 2015 under a demolition contract; the Forest Fire Lookout Association was not told in advance and no materials were salvaged

corrections.why: 15.2 m is 50 feet, the height of the 1926 pole tower. The tower standing until 2015 was the 67-foot tower named in NHLR (about 20.4 m).

corrections.proposed: 67-foot treated timber tower with R-6 flat cab (present tower from 1963), with the Aermotor MC-40 applying to the 1941 tower
corrections.why: NHLR describes the standing 1963 tower as a treated timber tower with an R-6 flat cab. The Aermotor label fits the earlier tower that was moved to Long Mountain.

resolved_conflicts.field: build year of the present tower
resolved_conflicts.explanation: 1963 per NHLR, FFLOS and Idaho Fire Lookouts; 1952 per the Forest Lookouts list. The story gives 1963, the date the Register and two other sites use, and notes the 1952 dating.
NHLR says August 9, 2011; FFLOS says July 9, 2011. The record uses NHLR's date.
NHLR says a 54-foot steel tower; the Forest Lookouts list says a 46-foot Aermotor MC-40 tower. The record keeps NHLR's description.

notes_for_editor: Brief events for 2008 (decision to remove) and 2014 (removal postponed) are not in the NHLR page, the FFLOS page, the Forest Lookouts list, firelookout.com or the 2015 chapter report, so they are omitted and need a source before they go back in. Access is set to public from land ownership and the 2022 description; no current access rule was found. The ground house is from NHLR only. Photo credits (Gary Weber, CDC Photography, Doug Miles) are not recorded because licences were not stated.
